faq.q: What is the origin of Mevlut?
faq.a: Mevlut is associated with Arabic. Mevlut is the Turkish form of Arabic مَوْلُود (Mawlūd), meaning 'born, newborn'.
Yes — the underlying form مَوْلُود is Arabic.
Mevlut can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Mevlut should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Mawlūd is not a Quranic personal name.
